description.zh: 一套 12 个 co-* 智能体专职代理编排体系在三个平台的移植版 monorepo，含跨包共享层。
description.en: A monorepo porting one 12-agent orchestration system to three platforms, with a cross-package shared layer.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 版 CoHub：Cordis 插件形态，双 preset 模式（纯调度 / 创造模式）、13 个技能、多模型共识工具。
description.en: CoHub for DeepSeek Harness: a Cordis plugin with dual presets (orchestrator / creation), 13 skills, and a multi-model council tool.

description.zh: CoHub Client端设置卡片（React）：为每个专职代理提供provider/model选择器，含调度参数、重试配置、停滞检测阈值、环境契约持久化开关。注入settings.plugin.item slot。
description.en: CoHub Client settings card (React): provider/model selectors per agent, plus schedule/retry/stall/contract config. Injected into settings.plugin.item slot.

description.zh: CoHub代理模型设置卡片：12技能各配provider/model+调度/重试/停滞/契约
description.en: CoHub agent model settings card per-skill provider/model+schedule/retry/stall/contract

description.zh: 7个co_* Cordis运行时工具（list/query/self/define/run/stop/remove）——只消费不注册，避免进程单例冲突。子模块：inspect（只读查询）+ lifecycle（定义/激活/停止/删除）。
description.en: 7 co_* Cordis runtime tools (list/query/self/define/run/stop/remove) — consume only, no registration, avoiding process-singleton conflicts. Sub-modules: inspect (read-only query) + lifecycle (define/activate/stop/delete).

description.zh: 三个只读查询工具：co_inspect_list（列出所有Provider）、co_inspect_query（按platform+provider+method查具体定义）、co_inspect_self（查当前会话自己管理/创建/激活的动态插件清单）。
description.en: Three read-only query tools: co_inspect_list (list all providers), co_inspect_query (fetch definition by platform+provider+method), co_inspect_self (inspect own session's dynamic plugin inventory).

description.zh: 列出Host端所有已知Cordis Inspect Provider
description.en: List all known Cordis Inspect Providers on host

description.zh: 按platform+provider+method查具体定义
description.en: Query specific definition by platform+provider+method

description.zh: 查当前会话自己管理/创建/激活的动态插件清单
description.en: Inspect own session dynamic plugin inventory

description.zh: 四个写操作工具：co_define（定义不可变Package）、co_run（激活/切换）、co_stop（停止保留定义）、co_remove（彻底删除）。Client端激活可能需要用户审批。
description.en: Four write tools: co_define (define immutable package), co_run (activate/switch), co_stop (stop but keep definition), co_remove (delete completely). Client-side activation may require user approval.

description.zh: 定义不可变Cordis Package（new/existing）
description.en: Define immutable Cordis Package (new/existing)

description.zh: 激活/切换动态插件（run/update）
description.en: Activate/switch dynamic plugin (run/update)

description.zh: 停止插件保留定义，可重新激活
description.en: Stop plugin keeping definition, re-runnable

description.zh: 彻底删除插件：停止+取消审批+删除所有版本
description.en: Completely remove: stop+cancel approvals+delete all versions

description.zh: M4 council_session工具：并行ctx.subagents.start()，每councillor通过agentOptions路由到配置的provider/model，结果聚合为结构化文本返回给co-council综合。
description.en: M4 council_session: parallel ctx.subagents.start(), each councillor routed via agentOptions, results aggregated as structured text for co-council synthesis.

description.zh: 并行启动多模型共识会议：所有councillor并行回答→聚合格式化
description.en: Parallel multi-model council: all councillors answer→aggregate+format

description.zh: 按skill名路由provider/model、注入精简指令后spawn子代理。子模块：tool（核心装配+spawn）与stall（停滞看门狗—旁路观测事件流、S1-S4判定提前中止）。支持P1环境契约注入、P1-2中止重试、P3-1停滞检测、P3-2契约持久化。
description.en: Routes by skill name to provider/model, injects brief, spawns subagents. Sub-modules: tool (core assembly+spawn) and stall (watchdog). Supports P1 contract injection, P1-2 retry, P3-1 stall detection, P3-2 contract persistence.

description.zh: 一次调用并行启动多个子代理任务的工具（上限20）。每task独立AbortController超时控制，跳过N2停滞检测和P1-2重试，保持简单可靠。复用delegate.ts共享函数。
description.en: Tool for parallel spawning of multiple subagent tasks (max 20). Per-task AbortController timeout; skips N2 and P1-2 retry. Reuses shared functions from delegate.ts.

description.zh: 批量并行启动子代理：每task独立AbortController+wallClockBudgetMs
description.en: Batch spawn: per-task AbortController + wallClockBudgetMs

description.zh: N2停滞检测器（P3-1）：挂全局session/event总线，按run.id归属子代理事件，在线估计S1-S4信号（连续同类错误/无结果空转/纯推理无动作/重复调用循环），提前中止子代理并复用P1重试机制。默认关闭。
description.en: N2 stall detector (P3-1): attaches to session/event bus, dispatches by run.id, estimates S1-S4 signals, pre-aborts and reuses P1 retry. Disabled by default.

description.zh: N2停滞看门狗类：attach→consume→S1-S4检查→abort回调
description.en: Stall watchdog: attach→consume→S1-S4 checks→abort callback

description.zh: createDelegateTool核心装配：skill匹配→路由provider/model→注入brief+环境契约→spawn子代理。P1-1契约注入、P1-2自动重试、P3-3运行时配置解析均在此。
description.en: Core assembly: skill match→route provider/model→inject brief+contract→spawn. P1-1/P1-2/P3-3 all live here.

description.zh: 按skill路由provider/model→spawn子代理；支持重试+停滞检测
description.en: Route by skill→spawn; retry+stall support

description.zh: P3-2（N1）执行器环境契约持久化：把P0/P1的每次探针升级为一次学习持续使用。包含环境指纹计算、缓存读写、契约文本生成、错误签名归一化与EnvSignatureLearner观测器。
description.en: P3-2 (N1) env-contract persistence: upgrade per-run probing to learn-once-reuse. Includes env fingerprint, cache read/write, contract text, error signature normalization, and EnvSignatureLearner.

description.zh: 环境契约学习器：挂事件总线→累计环境契约类错误签名→flush写缓存

description.zh: 内置agent preset的安装、升级与孤儿清理。通过.cohub-preset-install.json台账逐文件SHA-256比对：不丢修复（覆盖未改文件）、不踩用户自定义（跳过已改文件）、清理不再发布的孤儿preset。
description.en: Installs, upgrades, and cleans built-in agent presets via per-file SHA-256 ledger: never miss fixes, never overwrite user changes, remove orphaned presets.

description.zh: 安装/升级内置preset：逐文件SHA-256比对→覆盖未改/跳过已改/清理孤儿

description.zh: 为三平台 agent 系统提示词注入的中文强制指令文本。所有代理在思考、推理、回复时均须使用中文，代码与技术术语可保留原样。
description.en: Mandatory Chinese-language system-prompt text injected into all three platform agents. All agents must use Chinese for thinking, reasoning, and replies; code and technical terms may stay in English.

description.zh: 中文语言强制指令文本常量
description.en: Chinese language instruction constant

description.zh: 多模型共识的纯逻辑实现：类型定义、分词、Jaccard 相似度、成对一致性、共识判定、重试决策、结果格式化。子模块按 A 类（零依赖）→ B 类（仅依赖 A）→ 格式化 → 重试分层。
description.en: Pure-logic multi-model consensus: types, tokenization, Jaccard, pairwise agreement, consensus detection, retry decisions, result formatting. Sub-modules layered: class A → class B → formatting → retry.

description.zh: A类零依赖分词（tokenize / jaccard）+ B类成对一致性（pairwiseAgreement）与多模型共识判定（computeConsensus）。2n/3规则：≥ceil(2n/3)名议员平均一致性达阈值即共识。
description.en: Class-A zero-dep tokenization (tokenize/jaccard) + class-B pairwise agreement and multi-model consensus detection (computeConsensus). 2n/3 rule: consensus when ≥ceil(2n/3) councillors reach threshold agreement.

description.zh: 文本分词：小写→非字母数字+中文切分→去停用词
description.en: Tokenize: lowercase→split non-alpha+CJK→remove stopwords

description.zh: 两个token集合的Jaccard重叠系数
description.en: Jaccard overlap between two token sets

description.zh: 两个CouncillorSummary的成对一致性：0.5×结论重叠+0.5×实体重叠
description.en: Pairwise agreement: 0.5×conclusion overlap + 0.5×entity overlap

description.zh: 多模型共识判定：≥ceil(2n/3)议员平均一致性≥阈值即共识
description.en: Multi-model consensus: ≥ceil(2n/3) councillors with avg agreement ≥ threshold

description.zh: 模型引用解析（parseModelReference）、组合展示（formatModelComposition）、自适应键（adaptiveKey）、议员结果格式化（formatCouncillorResults）、协商prompt构建（buildDeliberationPrompt）等展示层函数。
description.en: Model reference parsing, composition display, adaptive keys, councillor result formatting, and deliberation prompt building — all presentation-layer functions.

description.zh: 格式化所有议员结果到结构化文本块，供council agent综合
description.en: Format all councillor results into structured text for council agent synthesis

description.zh: 合并用户prompt与可选的议员专属前缀
description.en: Merge user prompt with optional councillor-specific prefix

description.zh: 构建serial第二轮起的协商prompt：注入上一轮其他成员意见
description.en: Build deliberation prompt for serial round 2+: inject others' opinions

description.zh: 构建可读模型组合串，如"expert1: gpt-4, expert2: claude-3"
description.en: Build readable model composition string

description.zh: (strategy,agent)自适应参数表键
description.en: Adaptive parameter table key: (strategy,agent)

description.zh: 解析"provider/model"引用，格式无效返回null
description.en: Parse provider/model reference; returns null on invalid format

description.zh: 失败分类（timeout/empty/error/quality-low）、variant降级、重试预算（RetryBudget）、T2重试决策表（decideRetryAction：连击2次→needs-human，分类上限→give-up）与重试提示追加。
description.en: Failure classification, variant downgrade, retry budget (RetryBudget), T2 retry decision table (decideRetryAction), and retry context appending.

description.zh: T2重试决策表：consecutiveStreak≥2→needs-human，分类上限→give-up，否→retry
description.en: T2 retry decision: streak≥2→needs-human, limit reached→give-up, else→retry

description.zh: 错误消息→FailureCategory：empty/timeout/error
description.en: Map error message to failure category

description.zh: variant降级一步：max→high→medium→low→undefined
description.en: Downgrade variant one step: max→high→medium→low→undefined

description.zh: 按失败类别追加重试引导到prompt
description.en: Append retry guidance to prompt by failure category

description.zh: 共享重试预算：retriesLeft+maxElapsedMs+consumeRetry()
description.en: Shared retry budget: retriesLeft+maxElapsedMs+consumeRetry()

description.zh: 启发式从议员回复文本中提取结论句与关键实体/决策句。使用结论标记词（如"综上""结论""conclusion"）与实体标记词（如"决策""方案""entity"）匹配。
description.en: Heuristically extracts conclusion sentences and key entity/decision sentences from councillor response text using conclusion and entity markers.

description.zh: 启发式提取结构化摘要：分句→结论标记/实体标记匹配→返回conclusions+entities
description.en: Heuristic summary extraction: split sentences→match conclusion/entity markers→return conclusions+entities

description.zh: 先写临时文件再 rename，防止读取端拿到撕裂的 JSON。出错 re-throw 并 finally 清理 .tmp。提供文本与 JSON 两个变体。
description.en: Write to temp file then rename, preventing torn JSON reads. Re-throws on error with finally-cleanup. Provides text and JSON variants.

description.zh: 原子写入文本：写.tmp→rename→finally清理
description.en: Atomic text write: .tmp→rename→finally cleanup

description.zh: JSON.stringify后调用writeFileAtomic
description.en: JSON.stringify then writeFileAtomic

name.zh: 安全 JSON 文件读取

description.zh: 泛型安全读取 JSON 文件：文件缺失/解析失败/类型校验不通过均返回默认值，不会抛错。统一了 tracker 与 grep-counter 中的重复 try-cache 模式。
description.en: Generic safe JSON file reader: returns a default value on missing file, parse failure, or type-guard rejection — never throws. Unifies duplicated try-catch patterns from tracker and grep-counter.

description.zh: 安全读 JSON：existsSync→readFileSync→JSON.parse→可选 validate 类型守卫
description.en: Safe JSON read with optional type guard validate

description.zh: 从 "provider/model" 形式提取末尾模型名，供 council 结果与 UI 展示短标签。是共享层中最小、被三包共同引用的纯函数。
description.en: Extracts the trailing model name from a "provider/model" string for short labels in council results and UI. The smallest pure helper in the shared layer, referenced by all three platform packages.

description.zh: 从 provider/model 提取 / 后的模型名
description.en: Extract model name after / in provider/model

description.zh: 把 cohub-shared/src/ 下的共享源文件复制到三个平台包的 shared/ 子目录，附带自动生成头部与 SHA-256 漂移检测。--check 模式仅检测漂移（退出码 1 = 有漂移）。
description.en: Copies shared sources into three platform packages' shared/ dirs with auto-generated headers and SHA-256 drift detection. --check mode only detects drift (exit 1 = drift).

description.zh: 检测共享源到三包的漂移（退出码1=有漂移）；不加--check执行同步覆盖
description.en: Detect drift to three packages (exit 1=drift); without --check performs sync+overwrite

description.zh: CJK 感知的 token 估算器：中/日/韩字符按 1 token，其余按 0.25 token/字符。提供 estimateTokens / truncateByTokens / enforcePromptBudget 三个公用函数。
description.en: CJK-aware token estimator: CJK chars = 1 token, others = 0.25 token/char. Exports estimateTokens, truncateByTokens, and enforcePromptBudget.

description.zh: 估算文本token数：CJK 1 token/字符，其余 0.25
description.en: Estimate tokens: CJK 1/char, others 0.25/char

description.zh: 按token预算截断文本，超预算时保留头部
description.en: Truncate by token budget, keep head when over

description.zh: 强制prompt预算：未超→full；超→截断base
description.en: Enforce prompt budget: under→full; over→truncate base

description.zh: ZCode 版 CoHub：MCP stdio Server + hooks 形态，含 12 个技能、委派/共识/扫描工具与任务追踪器。
description.en: CoHub for ZCode: an MCP stdio server plus hooks, with 12 skills, delegation/council/scan tools, and a task tracker.

description.zh: ZCode 会话生命周期钩子：SessionStart（中文注入）、UserPromptSubmit（job-board / orchestrate-remind）、PreToolUse + PostToolUse（agent-tracker / grep-counter）。
description.en: ZCode session lifecycle hooks: SessionStart (Chinese injection), UserPromptSubmit (job-board / orchestrate-remind), PreToolUse + PostToolUse (agent-tracker / grep-counter).

description.zh: UserPromptSubmit hook：每次用户输入前刷新作业看板，展示运行中/已完成/失败的任务状态。
description.en: UserPromptSubmit hook: refreshes the job board before each user prompt, showing running/completed/failed task statuses.

reading.zh: 命令入口与配置读写。
reading.en: Command entry and configuration I/O.

reading.zh: 从左到右：类型契约 → 策略解析 → 提取 → 格式化 → 引擎统管。
reading.en: Left to right: type contracts, strategy resolution, extraction, formatting, and the engine that ties them together.

reading.zh: 按平台 hook 触发时机排列：配置 → 工具调用前后 → 会话事件 → 消息变换。
reading.en: Ordered by hook timing: config, tool call lifecycle, session events, then message transformation.

reading.zh: 类型 → 契约 → 重试 → 调度 → 引擎。
reading.en: Types, contract, retry, scheduler, engine.

reading.zh: 以 tracker 为核心，quality 与 stats 在其上做质量评估与统计。
reading.en: Tracker at the core, with quality assessment and statistics layered on top.

reading.zh: council 是核心工具，另外三个为它提供参数自适应、模型统计与任务终止。
reading.en: Council is the central tool; the other three supply adaptive parameters, model statistics, and job termination.

reading.zh: 从基础工具到文本/共识，最后是向三包分发代码的同步脚本。
reading.en: From base helpers to text and consensus, ending with the sync script that distributes code to the three packages.

reading.zh: 从左到右：分词与相似度 → 结论抽取 → 重试决策 → 结果格式化。
reading.en: Left to right: tokenizing and similarity, summary extraction, retry decisions, and result formatting.

reading.zh: ZCode 版是 MCP stdio Server + hooks 形态：入口暴露 4 个工具，hook 在会话各阶段旁路介入。
reading.en: The ZCode edition is an MCP stdio server plus hooks: the entry exposes four tools while hooks intervene at various session stages.

reading.zh: 类型 → 策略 → 提取 → 格式化 → 引擎。
reading.en: Types, strategy, extraction, formatting, engine.

reading.zh: 从共享的 stdin 读取，到各时机的 hook：会话启动 → 用户输入 → 工具调用前后。
reading.en: From the shared stdin reader to each hook timing: session start, user input, and tool call boundaries.

reading.zh: 12 个技能分四类（orchestrator 作为主代理不可 spawn）。
reading.en: Twelve skills in four classes (orchestrator is the non-spawnable primary agent).

reading.zh: 四个 MCP 工具：委派、共识、扫描、终止。
reading.en: Four MCP tools: delegation, council, scanning, and job termination.

reading.zh: 路径与常量在前，两个共享层重导出居中，日志收尾。
reading.en: Paths and constants first, the two shared-layer re-exports in the middle, and logging last.
